title: Trentina
description: Gateway traffic from Trentina's OTLP export and OpenRouter spend from its analytics API (RT #1544).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.title: Refused or failed

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome != "ok")
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.description: Calls whose outcome is anything but ok: defense blocks, guard denials, backend and gateway errors.

panels.title: Flagged by the defense

targets.query:

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.layer)
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.description: Calls where L1, L2 or L3 raised a detection, whether or not the call was refused.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> group()
  |> quantile(q: 0.95)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "openrouter_credits" and r._field == "balance")

from(bucket: "telegraf")

from(bucket: "telegraf")

from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

panels.description: Calls credited to each defense layer. A jump in L2 with no matching L3 flags is where to look for false positives.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.layer)
  |> group(columns: ["backend", "tool", "layer"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "calls"})
  |> keep(columns: ["backend", "tool", "layer", "calls"])

p50 = from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with destination_kind: if exists r.destination_kind then r.destination_kind else "tool"}))
  |> group(columns: ["destination_kind"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: median, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.destination_kind + " p50"}))

p95 = from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with destination_kind: if exists r.destination_kind then r.destination_kind else "tool"}))
  |> group(columns: ["destination_kind"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column), createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.destination_kind + " p95"}))

union(tables: [p50, p95])
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: OpenRouter spend per day by model

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStart, unit: 1d), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "openrouter_usage" and r._field == "cost")
  |> group(columns: ["model"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "model"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["model"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()

panels.description: From OpenRouter's analytics API, by UTC day. The last three days are re-read every 15 minutes as they settle.

panels.title: OpenRouter spend per day by agent key

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStart, unit: 1d), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "openrouter_usage" and r._field == "cost")
  |> group(columns: ["key"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "key"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["key"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()

import "date"
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStart, unit: 1d), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "openrouter_usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "requests" or r._field == "prompt_tokens" or r._field == "completion_tokens" or r._field == "reasoning_tokens" or r._field == "cost")
  |> group(columns: ["model", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["model"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["cost"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "openrouter_key" and r._field == "usage_daily")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["key"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "key"])
